data.body: ARTIFACTS AND OPEN WORK. Written this session: harness/EVIDENCE_RECORD.md (independence per cell, per-arm usage with backend-comparability caveats, itemised rebar invocations that left no artifact); artifacts/ballots/replicates/ 30 six-arm per-draw ballots plus SIX_ARM_INDEX.md; artifacts/ballots/merged/ 8 merged per-plan ballots (ballot_shape merged-draws/v1); harness/merge_ballot.py; harness/fidelity-pending/void-vs-instrument-failure-2948.md; wave3/quarantine/killed-variant-dispatch-2026-09-18/. The canonical non-recursive glob artifacts/ballots/*.ballot.json still returns exactly 40, so neither new shape can be mistaken for a canonical ballot. OPEN: finish collection (404 draws owed); the census reports rebar invocations paid for that left no artifact, now 30 with 26 inside the 40-plan universe and climbing as collection proceeds -- 6120-acda-BLOCK is 4 paid for 0 surviving, and this needs a cause before the report; phase-2 judging has never been run for the n=3 six-arm shape and has no runner script (three independent blind classifier sessions per plan, driven by harness/JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS*.md); harness/fidelity-pending/*.md still needs merging into FIDELITY_LOG.md; final report regeneration against n=3 data. Local-only numbers, including any spend figures, stay out of this log per machine-local policy.
